results.reply_draft: Hi Naledi, thanks for reaching out! The Pamper Party (4 to 6 guests, 2 hours, one treatment each plus bubbly) is R1 600 for 4 guests, plus R350 per extra guest, so for 6 of you that comes to R2 300. All get-togethers need a R500 deposit to secure the date, paid at least 7 days before. Please note we're closed on Sundays, so 13 December won't work. We're open Tuesday to Friday 09:00-18:00 and Saturday 08:00-14:00. Let us know a day that suits you and a team member will confirm the details with you. Warm regards, Example Salon
